blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More trains will be deployed at the Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (MRT-3) on Monday, November 2, in anticipation of the volume of passengers returning to Metro Manila after the Undas weekend, according to the Department of Transportation (DOTr). In a statement on Sunday, the DOTr said 19 trains would be deployed during peak hours on Monday. This is more than the regular holiday deployment of 14 trains during non-peak hours and 16 trains during peak hours.
